aToB.memory: Sharing Mooncrest Hall with Vivienne feels like sharing a roof with velvet silk when Kaede prefers rolled training sleeves. Though Kaede distrusts parlor diplomacy and rumor-trading on instinct, she caught Vivienne silently watching an evening wind-blade drill from the Dueling Courtyard edge once—not hunting gossip, just studying balance and timing with genuine, unexpected appreciation.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Kaede wants to speak plainly with Vivienne if they cross paths and ask bluntly what had a potions prodigy studying dueling footwork from the colonnade.

bToA.memory: Vivienne genuinely delights in fellow Mooncrest resident Kaede precisely because Kaede has zero capacity for polished dissembling. Her wind-blade choreography possesses effortless grace, and knowing Kaede despises courtly manipulation makes her honesty strangely comforting—even if Kaede squints suspiciously whenever Vivienne offers free Darjeeling tea.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Vivienne wants to compliment Kaede warmly on her razor-clean dueling form and engage Mooncrest's straightforward sword-ace in candid conversation without too much velvet wrapping.
